statement: Never exceed event capacity. Registration and cancellation mutate SQLite atomically; a cancellation can promote at most one oldest waiter.
purpose: Preserve booking integrity across feature and bugfix work.

statement: A full event joins the attendee to a FIFO waitlist. Cancellation of a confirmed registration promotes exactly one earliest live waiter. Retrying cancellation does not promote a second waiter.
purpose: Retain the waitlist feature during later fixes.

statement: Canonical email is trimmed and case-insensitive. Repeated requests and same-attendee registrations return the original row without consuming a seat or queue position. Reusing an idempotency key for another attendee/event fails atomically. After cancellation a fresh key may register again.

Registrations survive Durable Object eviction. Public event inventory never includes attendee names or email addresses. The browser must call the real API; API responses must correspond to persisted SQLite rows.
purpose: Keep UI, API and durable storage behavior together.
